setting.description: Enable the Crossref reference backfill plugin for this journal. When on, the plugin contributes parsed references to Crossref deposits for articles whose render galley isn't JATS XML.
setting.name: enable_crossref_refs_backfill

setting.description: URL of the GROBID instance used for Tier 3 (PDF-only) extraction. Tier 3 is silently skipped if GROBID isn't reachable. Default suits a same-host docker-compose setup.
setting.name: grobid_url
